male.arabic:
بِسْمِ اللّٰهِ الرَّحْمٰنِ الرَّحِيْمِ
اَلْحَمْدُ لِلّٰهِ رَبِّ الْعٰلَمِيْنَ
الرَّحْمٰنِ الرَّحِيْمِ
مٰلِكِ يَوْمِ الدِّيْنِ
اِيَّاكَ نَعْبُدُ وَاِيَّاكَ نَسْتَعِيْنُ
اِهْدِنَا الصِّرَاطَ الْمُسْتَقِيْمَ
صِرَاطَ الَّذِيْنَ اَنْعَمْتَ عَلَيْهِمْ غَيْرِ الْمَغْضُوْبِ عَلَيْهِمْ وَلَا الضَّاۤلِّيْنَ
male.latin:
Bismillāhir-raḥmānir-raḥīm.
Al-ḥamdu lillāhi rabbil-‘ālamīn.
Ar-raḥmānir-raḥīm.
Māliki yaumid-dīn.
Iyyāka na‘budu wa iyyāka nasta‘īn.
Ihdinaṣ-ṣirāṭal-mustaqīm.
Ṣirāṭallażīna an‘amta ‘alaihim gairil-magḍūbi ‘alaihim wa laḍ-ḍāllīn.
male.translation:
Dengan nama Allah Yang Maha Pengasih, Maha Penyayang.
Segala puji bagi Allah, Tuhan seluruh alam.
Yang Maha Pengasih, Maha Penyayang.
Pemilik hari pembalasan.
Hanya kepada Engkaulah kami menyembah dan hanya kepada Engkaulah kami mohon pertolongan.
Tunjukilah kami jalan yang lurus,
(yaitu) jalan orang-orang yang telah Engkau beri nikmat kepadanya; bukan jalan mereka yang dimurkai, dan bukan pula jalan mereka yang sesat.

steps.movementDescription: Doa utama setelah takbir ketiga.

male.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لَهُ وَارْحَمْهُ وَعَافِهِ وَاعْفُ عَنْهُ وَأَكْرِمْ نُزُلَهُ وَوَسِّعْ مُدْخَلَهُ وَاغْسِلْهُ بِالْمَاءِ وَالثَّلْجِ وَالْبَرَدِ وَنَقِّهِ مِنَ الْخَطَايَا كَمَا نَقَّيْتَ الثَّوْبَ الأَبْيَضَ مِنَ الدَّنَسِ وَأَبْدِلْهُ دَارًا خَيْرًا مِنْ دَارِهِ وَأَهْلاً خَيْرًا مِنْ أَهْلِهِ وَزَوْجًا خَيْرًا مِنْ زَوْجِهِ وَأَدْخِلْهُ الْجَنَّةَ وَأَعِذْهُ مِنْ عَذَابِ الْقَبْرِ أَوْ مِنْ عَذَابِ النَّارِ
male.latin: Allahummaghfir lahu warhamhu, wa afihi wa fu anhu, wa akrim nuzulahu, wa wassi mudkhalahu, waghsilhu bil-mai wats-tsalji wal-barad, wa naqqihi minal-khataya kama naqqaitats-tsaubal-abyadha minad-danas, wa abdilhu daran khairan min darihi, wa ahlan khairan min ahlihi, wa zaujan khairan min zaujihi, wa adkhilhul-jannah, wa a idzhu min adzabil-qabri au min adzabin-nar.
male.translation: Ya Allah, ampunilah dia (laki-laki), rahmatilah, selamatkan, maafkan, muliakan tempat singgahnya, luaskan tempat masuknya, sucikan dari kesalahan, gantikan rumah dan keluarga yang lebih baik, masukkan ke surga, dan lindungi dari azab kubur atau neraka.

female.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لَهَا وَارْحَمْهَا وَعَافِهَا وَاعْفُ عَنْهَا، وَأَكْرِمْ نُزُلَهَا، وَوَسِّعْ مَدْخَلَهَا، وَاغْسِلْهَا بِالْمَاءِ وَالثَّلْجِ وَالْبَرَدِ، وَنَقِّهَا مِنَ الْخَطَايَا كَمَا نَقَّيْتَ الثَّوْبَ اْلأَبْيَضَ مِنَ الدَّنَسِ، وَأَبْدِلْهَا دَارًا خَيْرًا مِنْ دَارِهَا، وَأَهْلًا خَيْرًا مِنْ أَهْلِهَا، وَزَوْجًا خَيْرًا مِنْ زَوْجِهَا، وَأَدْخِلْهَا الْجَنَّةَ، وَأَعِذْهَا مِنْ عَذَابِ الْقَبْرِ وَعَذَابِ النَّارِ
female.latin: Allahummaghfir laha warhamha, wa afiha wa fu anha, wa akrim nuzulaha, wa wassi mudkhalaha, waghsilha bil-mai wats-tsalji wal-barad, wa naqqiha minal-khataya kama naqqaitats-tsaubal-abyadha minad-danas, wa abdilha daran khairan min dariha, wa ahlan khairan min ahliha, wa zaujan khairan min zaujiha, wa adkhilhal-jannah, wa a idzha min adzabil-qabri wa adzabin-nar.
female.translation: Ya Allah, ampunilah dia (perempuan), rahmatilah, selamatkan, maafkan, muliakan tempat singgahnya, luaskan tempat masuknya, sucikan dari kesalahan, gantikan rumah dan keluarga yang lebih baik, masukkan ke surga, dan lindungi dari azab kubur dan neraka.

neutral.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لِحَيِّنَا وَمَيِّتِنَا، وَشَاهِدِنَا وَغَائِبِنَا، وَصَغِيرِنَا وَكَبِيرِنَا، وَذَكَرِنَا وَأُنْثَانَا
neutral.latin: Allahummaghfir lihayyina wa mayyitina, wa shahidina wa ghaibina, wa saghirina wa kabirina, wa dzakarina wa untsana.
neutral.translation: Ya Allah, ampunilah yang hidup dan yang wafat di antara kami, yang hadir dan tidak hadir, yang kecil dan besar, laki-laki dan perempuan.

male.latin: Allahummaghfir lahu warhamhu, wa afihi wa fu anhu, wa akrim nuzulahu, wa wassi mudkhalahu, waghsilhu bil-mai wats-tsalji wal-barad, wa naqqihi minal-khataya kama naqqaitats-tsaubal-abyadha minad-danas, wa abdilhu daran khairan min darihi, wa ahlan khairan min ahlihi, wa zaujan khairan min zaujihi, wa adkhilhul-jannah, wa a idzhu min adzabil-qabri au min adzabin-nar.
male.translation: Ya Allah, ampunilah dia (laki-laki), rahmatilah, selamatkan, maafkan, muliakan tempat singgahnya, luaskan tempat masuknya, sucikan dari kesalahan, gantikan rumah dan keluarga yang lebih baik, masukkan ke surga, dan lindungi dari azab kubur atau neraka.

female.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لَهَا وَارْحَمْهَا وَعَافِهَا وَاعْفُ عَنْهَا، وَأَكْرِمْ نُزُلَهَا، وَوَسِّعْ مَدْخَلَهَا، وَاغْسِلْهَا بِالْمَاءِ وَالثَّلْجِ وَالْبَرَدِ، وَنَقِّهَا مِنَ الْخَطَايَا كَمَا نَقَّيْتَ الثَّوْبَ اْلأَبْيَضَ مِنَ الدَّنَسِ، وَأَبْدِلْهَا دَارًا خَيْرًا مِنْ دَارِهَا، وَأَهْلًا خَيْرًا مِنْ أَهْلِهَا، وَزَوْجًا خَيْرًا مِنْ زَوْجِهَا، وَأَدْخِلْهَا الْجَنَّةَ، وَأَعِذْهَا مِنْ عَذَابِ الْقَبْرِ وَعَذَابِ النَّارِ
female.latin: Allahummaghfir laha warhamha, wa afiha wa fu anha, wa akrim nuzulaha, wa wassi mudkhalaha, waghsilha bil-mai wats-tsalji wal-barad, wa naqqiha minal-khataya kama naqqaitats-tsaubal-abyadha minad-danas, wa abdilha daran khairan min dariha, wa ahlan khairan min ahliha, wa zaujan khairan min zaujiha, wa adkhilhal-jannah, wa a idzha min adzabil-qabri wa adzabin-nar.
female.translation: Ya Allah, ampunilah dia (perempuan), rahmatilah, selamatkan, maafkan, muliakan tempat singgahnya, luaskan tempat masuknya, sucikan dari kesalahan, gantikan rumah dan keluarga yang lebih baik, masukkan ke surga, dan lindungi dari azab kubur dan neraka.

neutral.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لِحَيِّنَا وَمَيِّتِنَا، وَشَاهِدِنَا وَغَائِبِنَا، وَصَغِيرِنَا وَكَبِيرِنَا، وَذَكَرِنَا وَأُنْثَانَا
neutral.latin: Allahummaghfir lihayyina wa mayyitina, wa shahidina wa ghaibina, wa saghirina wa kabirina, wa dzakarina wa untsana.
neutral.translation: Ya Allah, ampunilah yang hidup dan yang wafat di antara kami, yang hadir dan tidak hadir, yang kecil dan besar, laki-laki dan perempuan.

slides.subtitleId: Dalil pokok: Hadis Jibril, Sahih Muslim 8a.
slides.subtitleEn: Main evidence: The Hadith of Jibril, Sahih Muslim 8a.
slides.bodyId: Iman bukan hanya nama daftar. Hadis Jibril menjabarkan enam landasan yang membentuk keyakinan, cara memandang kehidupan, dan pertanggungjawaban seorang Muslim: beriman kepada Allah, malaikat-Nya, kitab-kitab-Nya, rasul-rasul-Nya, Hari Akhir, serta qadar yang baik maupun yang terasa buruk.
slides.bodyEn: The Pillars of Faith (Arkan al-Iman) are six, and their clearest foundation is found in the Hadith of Jibril. In this hadith, the Angel Jibril asked the Prophet about faith, and the Prophet explained the six fundamental principles of belief.
slides.instructionId: Pelajari keenam unsur sebagai satu kesatuan; setiap laman berikut menjelaskan isi dan dampaknya dalam kehidupan.
slides.instructionEn: Study the six principles as one foundation; the following pages explain each principle and its effect on life.

reference.numberingNote: HR. Muslim no. 8

passages.introId: Dari ‘Umar bin al-Khaththab radhiyallahu ‘anhu, Jibril bertanya kepada Rasulullah ﷺ:
passages.introEn: From ‘Umar ibn al-Khattab, may Allah be pleased with him, Jibril asked the Messenger of Allah ﷺ:
The Messenger of Allah ﷺ replied:
passages.arabicText: أَنْ تُؤْمِنَ بِاللَّهِ، وَمَلَائِكَتِهِ، وَكُتُبِهِ، وَرُسُلِهِ، وَالْيَوْمِ الْآخِرِ، وَتُؤْمِنَ بِالْقَدَرِ خَيْرِهِ وَشَرِّهِ
passages.latinText: An tu’mina billahi, wa mala’ikatihi, wa kutubihi, wa rusulihi, wal-yaumil-akhiri, wa tu’mina bil-qadari khairihi wa sharrihi.
passages.translationId: Engkau beriman kepada Allah, para malaikat-Nya, kitab-kitab-Nya, rasul-rasul-Nya, Hari Akhir, dan engkau beriman kepada takdir, yang baik maupun yang buruk.
passages.translationEn: It is that you believe in Allah, His angels, His Books, His Messengers, the Last Day, and that you believe in divine decree, both its good and its bad.

slides.bodyId: Meyakini Allah sebagai satu-satunya Tuhan yang berhak disembah. Keyakinan ini menuntun doa, ibadah, ketaatan, rasa takut, harap, dan tawakal hanya kepada-Nya. Iman kepada Allah menjadi pusat seluruh rukun iman; ketaatan seorang mukmin lahir dari sikap mendengar dan taat kepada petunjuk-Nya.

Iman kepada Allah menjadi pusat seluruh rukun iman; ketaatan seorang mukmin lahir dari sikap mendengar dan taat kepada petunjuk-Nya.

slides.bodyId: Meyakini malaikat sebagai makhluk gaib ciptaan Allah yang menjalankan tugas menurut perintah-Nya. Seorang Muslim menerima keberadaan mereka berdasarkan wahyu, tanpa menggambarkan hakikat yang tidak dijelaskan dalil. Kesadaran akan dunia gaib mendidik kehati-hatian, ketaatan, dan tanggung jawab.

Keyakinan ini membuat perbuatan tidak dipandang tanpa akibat: kebaikan dikerjakan dengan harap kepada Allah, sedangkan dosa dihindari karena setiap manusia akan kembali dan mempertanggungjawabkan amalnya.

slides.bodyId: Meyakini ketetapan Allah, termasuk yang baik maupun yang terasa buruk bagi manusia. Iman kepada qadar tidak menghapus kewajiban berusaha, berdoa, memilih yang benar, dan bertanggung jawab. Ia menumbuhkan syukur ketika memperoleh nikmat, sabar ketika diuji, serta tidak putus asa dari rahmat Allah.

records.arabic: عَنْ أَمِيرِ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ أَبِي حَفْصٍ عُمَرَ بْنِ الْخَطَّابِ رَضِيَ اللهُ عَنْهُ قَالَ: سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ: " إنَّمَا الْأَعْمَالُ بِالنِّيَّاتِ، وَإِنَّمَا لِكُلِّ امْرِئٍ مَا نَوَى، فَمَنْ كَانَتْ هِجْرَتُهُ إلَى اللَّهِ وَرَسُولِهِ فَهِجْرَتُهُ إلَى اللَّهِ وَرَسُولِهِ، وَمَنْ كَانَتْ هِجْرَتُهُ لِدُنْيَا يُصِيبُهَا أَوْ امْرَأَةٍ يَنْكِحُهَا فَهِجْرَتُهُ إلَى مَا هَاجَرَ إلَيْهِ". رَوَاهُ إِمَامَا الْمُحَدِّثِينَ أَبُو عَبْدِ اللهِ مُحَمَّدُ بنُ إِسْمَاعِيل بن إِبْرَاهِيم بن الْمُغِيرَة بن بَرْدِزبَه الْبُخَارِيُّ الْجُعْفِيُّ [رقم:1]، وَأَبُو الْحُسَيْنِ مُسْلِمٌ بنُ الْحَجَّاج بن مُسْلِم الْقُشَيْرِيُّ النَّيْسَابُورِيُّ [رقم:1907] رَضِيَ اللهُ عَنْهُمَا فِي "صَحِيحَيْهِمَا" اللذَينِ هُمَا أَصَحُّ الْكُتُبِ الْمُصَنَّفَةِ

records.arabic: عَنْ عُمَرَ رَضِيَ اللهُ عَنْهُ أَيْضًا قَالَ: بَيْنَمَا نَحْنُ جُلُوسٌ عِنْدَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه و سلم ذَاتَ يَوْمٍ، إذْ طَلَعَ عَلَيْنَا رَجُلٌ شَدِيدُ بَيَاضِ الثِّيَابِ، شَدِيدُ سَوَادِ الشَّعْرِ، لَا يُرَى عَلَيْهِ أَثَرُ السَّفَرِ، وَلَا يَعْرِفُهُ مِنَّا أَحَدٌ. حَتَّى جَلَسَ إلَى النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه و سلم . فَأَسْنَدَ رُكْبَتَيْهِ إلَى رُكْبَتَيْهِ، وَوَضَعَ كَفَّيْهِ عَلَى فَخِذَيْهِ، وَقَالَ: يَا مُحَمَّدُ أَخْبِرْنِي عَنْ الْإِسْلَامِ. فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه و سلم الْإِسْلَامُ أَنْ تَشْهَدَ أَنْ لَا إلَهَ إلَّا اللَّهُ وَأَنَّ مُحَمَّدًا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ، وَتُقِيمَ الصَّلَاةَ، وَتُؤْتِيَ الزَّكَاةَ، وَتَصُومَ رَمَضَانَ، وَتَحُجَّ الْبَيْتَ إنْ اسْتَطَعْت إلَيْهِ سَبِيلًا. قَالَ: صَدَقْت . فَعَجِبْنَا لَهُ يَسْأَلُهُ وَيُصَدِّقُهُ! قَالَ: فَأَخْبِرْنِي عَنْ الْإِيمَانِ. قَالَ: أَنْ تُؤْمِنَ بِاَللَّهِ وَمَلَائِكَتِهِ وَكُتُبِهِ وَرُسُلِهِ وَالْيَوْمِ الْآخِرِ، وَتُؤْمِنَ بِالْقَدَرِ خَيْرِهِ وَشَرِّهِ. قَالَ: صَدَقْت. قَالَ: فَأَخْبِرْنِي عَنْ الْإِحْسَانِ. قَالَ: أَنْ تَعْبُدَ اللَّهَ كَأَنَّك تَرَاهُ، فَإِنْ لَمْ تَكُنْ تَرَاهُ فَإِنَّهُ يَرَاك. قَالَ: فَأَخْبِرْنِي عَنْ السَّاعَةِ. قَالَ: مَا الْمَسْئُولُ عَنْهَا بِأَعْلَمَ مِنْ السَّائِلِ. قَالَ: فَأَخْبِرْنِي عَنْ أَمَارَاتِهَا؟ قَالَ: أَنْ تَلِدَ الْأَمَةُ رَبَّتَهَا، وَأَنْ تَرَى الْحُفَاةَ الْعُرَاةَ الْعَالَةَ رِعَاءَ الشَّاءِ يَتَطَاوَلُونَ فِي الْبُنْيَانِ. ثُمَّ انْطَلَقَ، فَلَبِثْتُ مَلِيًّا، ثُمَّ قَالَ: يَا عُمَرُ أَتَدْرِي مَنْ السَّائِلُ؟. ‫‬قُلْتُ: اللَّهُ وَرَسُولُهُ أَعْلَمُ. قَالَ: فَإِنَّهُ جِبْرِيلُ أَتَاكُمْ يُعَلِّمُكُمْ دِينَكُمْ . [رَوَاهُ مُسْلِمٌ]

records.arabic: عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُمَرَ بْنِ الْخَطَّابِ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُمَا قَالَ: سَمِعْت رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه و سلم يَقُولُ: بُنِيَ الْإِسْلَامُ عَلَى خَمْسٍ: شَهَادَةِ أَنْ لَا إلَهَ إلَّا اللَّهُ وَأَنَّ مُحَمَّدًا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ، وَإِقَامِ الصَّلَاةِ، وَإِيتَاءِ الزَّكَاةِ، وَحَجِّ الْبَيْتِ، وَصَوْمِ رَمَضَانَ . records.translation: It is narrated on the authority of Amirul Mu'minin, Abu Hafs 'Umar bin al-Khattab (ra) who said: I heard the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) say: "Actions are (judged) by motives (niyyah), so each man will have what he intended. Thus, he whose migration (hijrah) was to Allah and His Messenger, his migration is to Allah and His Messenger; but he whose migration was for some worldly thing he might gain, or for a wife he might marry, his migration is to that for which he migrated." [Bukhari & Muslim]
records.matn: عَنْ أَمِيرِ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ أَبِي حَفْصٍ عُمَرَ بْنِ الْخَطَّابِ رَضِيَ اللهُ عَنْهُ قَالَ: سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ: " إنَّمَا الْأَعْمَالُ بِالنِّيَّاتِ، وَإِنَّمَا لِكُلِّ امْرِئٍ مَا نَوَى، فَمَنْ كَانَتْ هِجْرَتُهُ إلَى اللَّهِ وَرَسُولِهِ فَهِجْرَتُهُ إلَى اللَّهِ وَرَسُولِهِ، وَمَنْ كَانَتْ هِجْرَتُهُ لِدُنْيَا يُصِيبُهَا أَوْ امْرَأَةٍ يَنْكِحُهَا فَهِجْرَتُهُ إلَى مَا هَاجَرَ إلَيْهِ". رَوَاهُ إِمَامَا الْمُحَدِّثِينَ أَبُو عَبْدِ اللهِ مُحَمَّدُ بنُ إِسْمَاعِيل بن إِبْرَاهِيم بن الْمُغِيرَة بن بَرْدِزبَه الْبُخَارِيُّ الْجُعْفِيُّ [رقم:1]، وَأَبُو الْحُسَيْنِ مُسْلِمٌ بنُ الْحَجَّاج بن مُسْلِم الْقُشَيْرِيُّ النَّيْسَابُورِيُّ [رقم:1907] رَضِيَ اللهُ عَنْهُمَا فِي "صَحِيحَيْهِمَا" اللذَينِ هُمَا أَصَحُّ الْكُتُبِ الْمُصَنَّفَةِ

records.arabic: عَنْ عُمَرَ رَضِيَ اللهُ عَنْهُ أَيْضًا قَالَ: بَيْنَمَا نَحْنُ جُلُوسٌ عِنْدَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه و سلم ذَاتَ يَوْمٍ، إذْ طَلَعَ عَلَيْنَا رَجُلٌ شَدِيدُ بَيَاضِ الثِّيَابِ، شَدِيدُ سَوَادِ الشَّعْرِ، لَا يُرَى عَلَيْهِ أَثَرُ السَّفَرِ، وَلَا يَعْرِفُهُ مِنَّا أَحَدٌ. حَتَّى جَلَسَ إلَى النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه و سلم . فَأَسْنَدَ رُكْبَتَيْهِ إلَى رُكْبَتَيْهِ، وَوَضَعَ كَفَّيْهِ عَلَى فَخِذَيْهِ، وَقَالَ: يَا مُحَمَّدُ أَخْبِرْنِي عَنْ الْإِسْلَامِ. فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه و سلم الْإِسْلَامُ أَنْ تَشْهَدَ أَنْ لَا إلَهَ إلَّا اللَّهُ وَأَنَّ مُحَمَّدًا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ، وَتُقِيمَ الصَّلَاةَ، وَتُؤْتِيَ الزَّكَاةَ، وَتَصُومَ رَمَضَانَ، وَتَحُجَّ الْبَيْتَ إنْ اسْتَطَعْت إلَيْهِ سَبِيلًا. قَالَ: صَدَقْت . فَعَجِبْنَا لَهُ يَسْأَلُهُ وَيُصَدِّقُهُ! قَالَ: فَأَخْبِرْنِي عَنْ الْإِيمَانِ. قَالَ: أَنْ تُؤْمِنَ بِاَللَّهِ وَمَلَائِكَتِهِ وَكُتُبِهِ وَرُسُلِهِ وَالْيَوْمِ الْآخِرِ، وَتُؤْمِنَ بِالْقَدَرِ خَيْرِهِ وَشَرِّهِ. قَالَ: صَدَقْت. قَالَ: فَأَخْبِرْنِي عَنْ الْإِحْسَانِ. قَالَ: أَنْ تَعْبُدَ اللَّهَ كَأَنَّك تَرَاهُ، فَإِنْ لَمْ تَكُنْ تَرَاهُ فَإِنَّهُ يَرَاك. قَالَ: فَأَخْبِرْنِي عَنْ السَّاعَةِ. قَالَ: مَا الْمَسْئُولُ عَنْهَا بِأَعْلَمَ مِنْ السَّائِلِ. قَالَ: فَأَخْبِرْنِي عَنْ أَمَارَاتِهَا؟ قَالَ: أَنْ تَلِدَ الْأَمَةُ رَبَّتَهَا، وَأَنْ تَرَى الْحُفَاةَ الْعُرَاةَ الْعَالَةَ رِعَاءَ الشَّاءِ يَتَطَاوَلُونَ فِي الْبُنْيَانِ. ثُمَّ انْطَلَقَ، فَلَبِثْتُ مَلِيًّا، ثُمَّ قَالَ: يَا عُمَرُ أَتَدْرِي مَنْ السَّائِلُ؟. ‫‬قُلْتُ: اللَّهُ وَرَسُولُهُ أَعْلَمُ. قَالَ: فَإِنَّهُ جِبْرِيلُ أَتَاكُمْ يُعَلِّمُكُمْ دِينَكُمْ . [رَوَاهُ مُسْلِمٌ]
records.translation: Also on the authority of `Umar (ra) who said: While we were one day sitting with the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) there appeared before us a man dressed in extremely white clothes and with very black hair. No traces of journeying were visible on him, and none of us knew him. He sat down close by the Prophet (ﷺ) rested his knees against the knees of the Prophet (ﷺ) and placed his palms over his thighs, and said: "O Muhammad! Inform me about Islam." The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) replied: "Islam is that you should testify that there is no deity worthy of worship except Allah and that Muhammad is His Messenger (ﷺ), that you should perform salah (ritual prayer), pay the zakah, fast during Ramadan, and perform Hajj (pilgrimage) to the House (the Ka`bah at Makkah), if you can find a way to it (or find the means for making the journey to it)." He said: "You have spoken the truth." We were astonished at his thus questioning him (ﷺ) and then telling him that he was right, but he went on to say, "Inform me about Iman (faith)." He (the Prophet) answered, "It is that you believe in Allah and His angels and His Books and His Messengers and in the Last Day, and in fate (qadar), both in its good and in its evil aspects." He said, "You have spoken the truth." Then he (the man) said, "Inform me about Ihsan." He (the Prophet) answered, "It is that you should serve Allah as though you could see Him, for though you cannot see Him yet He sees you." He said, "Inform me about the Hour." He (the Prophet) said, "About that the one questioned knows no more than the questioner." So he said, "Well, inform me about its signs." He said, "They are that the slave-girl will give birth to her mistress and that you will see the barefooted ones, the naked, the destitute, the herdsmen of the sheep (competing with each other) in raising lofty buildings." Thereupon the man went off. I waited a while, and then he (the Prophet) said, "O `Umar, do you know who that questioner was?" I replied, "Allah and His Messenger know better." He said, "That was Jibril. He came to teach you your religion." [Muslim]

records.arabic: عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُمَرَ بْنِ الْخَطَّابِ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُمَا قَالَ: سَمِعْت رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه و سلم يَقُولُ: بُنِيَ الْإِسْلَامُ عَلَى خَمْسٍ: شَهَادَةِ أَنْ لَا إلَهَ إلَّا اللَّهُ وَأَنَّ مُحَمَّدًا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ، وَإِقَامِ الصَّلَاةِ، وَإِيتَاءِ الزَّكَاةِ، وَحَجِّ الْبَيْتِ، وَصَوْمِ رَمَضَانَ . [رَوَاهُ الْبُخَارِيُّ] ، [وَمُسْلِمٌ]
records.translation: On the authority of Abdullah, the son of Umar ibn al-Khattab (ra), who said: I heard the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) say, "Islam has been built on five [pillars]: testifying that there is no deity worthy of worship except Allah and that Muhammad is the Messenger of Allah, establishing the salah (prayer), paying the zakat (obligatory charity), making the hajj (pilgrimage) to the House, and fasting in Ramadhan." [Bukhari & Muslim]

units.title: Bacaan tunggal Alif — أَ
units.instruction: Baca أَ dengan bunyi a pendek.
units.explanation: أَ adalah hamzah di atas Alif dengan fathah. Bacaan a pendek ini berbeda dari Alif mad pada بَا yang memanjangkan bunyi ba.

items.instruction: Bacaan tunggal Alif berfathah: a pendek.
items.pronunciationHint: Ucapkan a pendek, tidak dipanjangkan. Bentuk أَ memakai hamzah di atas Alif dan fathah; bedakan dari Alif mad pada بَا (bā).

units.title: Single Alif reading — أَ
units.instruction: Read أَ with a short a sound.
units.explanation: أَ is hamza on Alif with fathah. This short a sound differs from the madd Alif in بَا, which lengthens ba.

items.instruction: Single Alif with fathah: short a.
items.pronunciationHint: Say a short a, without lengthening it. The form أَ has hamza above Alif and fathah; distinguish it from the madd Alif in بَا (bā).

course.title: Iqro · Kompetensi Membaca Bertahap
course.description: Enam jilid berbasis kemampuan membaca. Materi, Review, Test, dan Riwayat memakai alur serta penyimpanan yang terpisah.

levels.title: Iqro 1 · Bacaan Fathah Tunggal
levels.description: Membaca bunyi pendek أَ بَ تَ ثَ dan kelompok huruf berfathah secara bertahap.

lessons.title: Bacaan awal Alif, Ba, Ta, Tsa — أَ بَ تَ ثَ
lessons.objective: Membaca bunyi huruf berfathah secara langsung dan pendek tanpa mengeja nama huruf.
lessons.targetCompetency: Mampu membedakan dan membaca kelompok أَ بَ تَ ثَ نَ يَ مَ لَ.

lessons.title: Fathah dan bentuk yang berdekatan
lessons.objective: Membedakan titik, bentuk, dan bunyi huruf berfathah dalam kelompok kecil.
lessons.targetCompetency: Membaca kelompok جَ حَ خَ, دَ ذَ, رَ زَ, سَ شَ, dan bentuk lanjutan tanpa daftar alfabet.

levels.title: Iqro 2 · Sambungan dan Mad Fathah
levels.description: Membaca bentuk awal, tengah, akhir yang tersambung; Alif diperkenalkan sebagai fungsi pemanjang setelah fathah.

lessons.title: Huruf sambung berfathah
lessons.objective: Mengenali perubahan bentuk ketika huruf berada di awal, tengah, dan akhir rangkaian.
lessons.targetCompetency: Membaca rangkaian fathah dua sampai empat huruf dengan lancar.

lessons.title: Mad Alif setelah fathah
lessons.objective: Membedakan bunyi fathah pendek dengan bunyi panjang dua harakat yang diikuti Alif.
lessons.targetCompetency: Membaca pasangan pendek-panjang dan membedakan Alif mad dari bacaan a pendek.

levels.title: Iqro 3 · Kasrah, Dhammah, dan Mad
levels.description: Menambah vokal i/u pada bentuk tunggal dan sambung, lalu membedakan mad Ya dan Waw.

lessons.title: Kasrah dan dhammah
lessons.objective: Membaca kasrah dan dhammah pada huruf tunggal maupun rangkaian sederhana.
lessons.targetCompetency: Membedakan a, i, dan u pendek pada bentuk yang sama.

lessons.title: Mad Ya dan Waw
lessons.objective: Membandingkan vokal pendek dengan i/u panjang dua harakat.
lessons.targetCompetency: Membaca mad dasar Alif, Ya, dan Waw dalam rangkaian sederhana.

levels.title: Iqro 4 · Tanwin, Sukun, dan Qalqalah
levels.description: Membaca harakat ganda, huruf mati, serta pantulan qalqalah pada contoh yang sesuai.

lessons.title: Fathatain, kasratain, dammatain
lessons.objective: Membaca tiga bentuk tanwin dengan bunyi akhir n yang jelas.
lessons.targetCompetency: Membedakan an, in, dan un dalam kata latihan.

lessons.title: Sukun dan qalqalah dasar
lessons.objective: Menahan vokal pada huruf bersukun dan mengenali pantulan qalqalah tanpa menambah vokal.
lessons.targetCompetency: Membaca sukun di tengah/akhir serta contoh qalqalah dasar.

levels.title: Iqro 5 · Tasydid dan Pola Tajwid Dasar
levels.description: Membaca konsonan rangkap, Alif-Lam qamariyah/syamsiyah, dan kombinasi tanda yang telah dipelajari.

lessons.title: Tasydid dalam rangkaian
lessons.objective: Membaca huruf bertasydid sebagai konsonan rangkap dengan harakat yang tepat.
lessons.targetCompetency: Membaca tasydid yang berpadu dengan fathah, kasrah, dhammah, dan mad.

lessons.title: Alif-Lam qamariyah dan syamsiyah
lessons.objective: Membedakan Lam yang dibaca jelas dan Lam yang melebur pada huruf syamsiyah.
lessons.targetCompetency: Membaca beberapa pola Alif-Lam tanpa bergantung pada transliterasi.

levels.title: Iqro 6 · Kombinasi dan Bacaan Ayat
levels.description: Menggabungkan nun/mim sukun, pola tajwid dasar, frasa, dan ayat pendek dengan rujukan kanonik.

lessons.title: Nun/Mim sukun dan kombinasi bacaan
lessons.objective: Membaca pertemuan nun/mim sukun secara terbimbing dan mengenali area yang perlu koreksi guru.
lessons.targetCompetency: Membaca kombinasi lanjutan dengan panjang-pendek dan dengung yang terjaga.

lessons.title: Frasa dan ayat pendek
lessons.objective: Menerapkan seluruh kompetensi pada ayat pendek yang diambil dari database Qur’an kanonik.
lessons.targetCompetency: Membaca ayat pendek berurutan dengan tartil dasar dan siap disimak penguji.

reminders.title: Dirikan Sholat
reminders.arabicText: وَأَقِيمُوا الصَّلَاةَ وَآتُوا الزَّكَاةَ وَارْكَعُوا مَعَ الرَّاكِعِينَ
reminders.content: Dirikanlah sholat, tunaikanlah zakat, dan rukuklah beserta orang-orang yang rukuk.
reminders.translation: Pesan: jagalah sholat sebagai bentuk ketaatan dan penghambaan kepada Allah.

reminders.title: Sholat Mencegah Keburukan
reminders.arabicText: إِنَّ الصَّلَاةَ تَنْهَىٰ عَنِ الْفَحْشَاءِ وَالْمُنكَرِ
reminders.content: Sesungguhnya sholat mencegah dari perbuatan keji dan mungkar.
reminders.translation: Makna: sholat yang dijaga dengan baik membentuk akhlak dan menahan diri dari keburukan.

reminders.title: Menjaga Sholat
reminders.content: Peliharalah semua sholat dan sholat wustha.
reminders.translation: Makna: setiap waktu sholat perlu dijaga, tidak ditunda tanpa alasan.

reminders.title: Sholat Tepat Waktu
reminders.content: Di antara amalan yang paling dicintai Allah adalah sholat pada waktunya.
reminders.translation: Makna: saat waktu sholat tiba, dahulukan panggilan Allah sebelum urusan lain.

reminders.title: Sholat Berjamaah
reminders.content: Sholat berjamaah memiliki keutamaan yang jauh lebih besar daripada sholat sendirian.
reminders.translation: Makna: datang ke masjid dan merapatkan saf adalah bagian dari menjaga kekuatan jamaah.

reminders.title: Sholat Adalah Cahaya
reminders.translation: Makna: sholat menerangi hati, sikap, dan jalan hidup seorang muslim.

reminders.title: Saf Sholat
reminders.content: Luruskan saf, rapatkan barisan, dan tenangkan hati sebelum takbir.

tafsir.text: In the Name of God the name of a thing is that by which it can be known. The Names of God exalted be He are the archetypal forms ṣuwar nawʿiyya whose specificities and ipseities hūwiyya indicate the attributes of God and His essence and which indicate by their very existence His countenance and by their individuation His oneness. For these are the outward manifestations through which He can be known; Allāh is a name for the divine essence qua essence absolutely without taking into consideration that it may be qualified by the attributes or indeed taking into consideration that it may not be so qualified; the Compassionate is the one who causes existence and perfection to flow upon all things in the measure that divine wisdom requires and to the capacity of the receiving entities qawābil from the outset of their creation; the Merciful al-Raḥīm is the one who bestows the spiritual perfection kamāl maʿnawī that has been earmarked for the human species in the end sc. in the Hereafter. It is for this reason that they say O You Who are the Compassionate One of this world and of the Hereafter yā raḥmān al-dunyā wa'l-ākhira but say O Merciful One of the Hereafter raḥīm al-ākhira the meaning then is in the perfect human all-encompassing form general and specific mercy which is the locus of manifestation of the divine essence and the greatest truth with the totality of attributes I commence and I recite. It Allāh is the Greatest Name of God. It is to this meaning that the Prophet's ṣlʿm alluded when he said 'I have been given the sum of all excellent speech sc. The QurÌān and have been sent to complete the noble character traits makārim al-akhlāq. For words constitute the realities ḥaqāÌiq of existents mawjūdāt and their concrete substances aʿyān just as Jesus peace be upon him was called a Word from God cf. 33945. The noble character traits are the perfections of these existents and represent their specifities constituting the sources of their the existents' actions in their entirety contained as they are in the comprehensive human microcosm kawn insānī. Herein lies a subtlety la?īfa namely that the prophets peace be upon them have made the letters of the alphabet analogous to the ranks of existents marātib al-mawjūdāt.

tafsir.text: Master of the Day of Judgement that is the day of requite the Day of Resurrection. The reason for the specific mention of the Day of Judgement is that the mastery of none shall appear on that Day except that of God may He be exalted as is indicated by God’s words ‘Whose is the Kingdom today?’ ‘God’s’ Q. 4016 if one reads it mālik as opposed to malik then this signifies that He has possession of the entire affair on the Day of Resurrection or else that He is ever described by this expression in the same way as He is described as ‘Forgiver of sin’ ghāfir al-dhanb. Thus one can validly take it as an adjective of a definite noun.

The Names of God exalted be He are the archetypal forms ṣuwar nawʿiyya whose specificities and ipseities hūwiyya indicate the attributes of God and His essence and which indicate by their very existence His countenance and by their individuation His oneness. For these are the outward manifestations through which He can be known; Allāh is a name for the divine essence qua essence absolutely without taking into consideration that it may be qualified by the attributes or indeed taking into consideration that it may not be so qualified; the Compassionate is the one who causes existence and perfection to flow upon all things in the measure that divine wisdom requires and to the capacity of the receiving entities qawābil from the outset of their creation; the Merciful al-Raḥīm is the one who bestows the spiritual perfection kamāl maʿnawī that has been earmarked for the human species in the end sc. in the Hereafter. It is for this reason that they say O You Who are the Compassionate One of this world and of the Hereafter yā raḥmān al-dunyā wa'l-ākhira but say O Merciful One of the Hereafter raḥīm al-ākhira the meaning then is in the perfect human all-encompassing form general and specific mercy which is the locus of manifestation of the divine essence and the greatest truth with the totality of attributes I commence and I recite. It Allāh is the Greatest Name of God. It is to this meaning that the Prophet's ṣlʿm alluded when he said 'I have been given the sum of all excellent speech sc. The QurÌān and have been sent to complete the noble character traits makārim al-akhlāq. For words constitute the realities ḥaqāÌiq of existents mawjūdāt and their concrete substances aʿyān just as Jesus peace be upon him was called a Word from God cf. 33945. The noble character traits are the perfections of these existents and represent their specifities constituting the sources of their the existents' actions in their entirety contained as they are in the comprehensive human microcosm kawn insānī. Herein lies a subtlety la?īfa namely that the prophets peace be upon them have made the letters of the alphabet analogous to the ranks of existents marātib al-mawjūdāt.

The reason for the specific mention of the Day of Judgement is that the mastery of none shall appear on that Day except that of God may He be exalted as is indicated by God’s words ‘Whose is the Kingdom today?’ ‘God’s’ Q. 4016 if one reads it mālik as opposed to malik then this signifies that He has possession of the entire affair on the Day of Resurrection or else that He is ever described by this expression in the same way as He is described as ‘Forgiver of sin’ ghāfir al-dhanb. Thus one can validly take it as an adjective of a definite noun.

tafsir.text: the path of those whom You have favoured with guidance from alladhīna together with its relative clause is substituted by ghayri l-maghdūbi ‘alayhim not the path of those against whom there is wrath namely the Jews and nor of those who are astray namely the Christians. The subtle meaning implied by this substitution is that the guided ones are neither the Jews nor the Christians. But God knows best what is right and to Him is the Return and the final Resort. May God bless our master Muhammad (s) his Family and Companions and grant them everlasting peace. Sufficient is God for us; an excellent Guardian is He. There is no power and no strength save in God the High the Tremendous.
